decisions.reason: The garage door operators have their own page and complement the core door range, so they are cheap to keep while their value is still unresolved after one year.

The solid wood sectional door is a niche variant and is only mentioned on the website, but one year is too early for the uncertainty to resolve, and keeping it within the existing sectional door line costs little.
The remote-controlled operator overlaps with Product A, but it is a low-cost accessory option whose demand is still uncertain.
This glazed industrial sectional door overlaps with Products E and F, which makes consolidation possible, but it shares production and carrying it costs little while results are still unclear.
The insulated glazed variant targets demand for thermal efficiency, so the option still has value at low carrying cost.
It has its own page, which signals commitment, and it fits the core industrial door business, so keeping it is justified.
